name: Sorriso
blurb: Sorriso is Italian for smile. Specialty coffee, Neapolitan pizza, hummus plates and cheesecakes in Nana Varachha — from the first pour at 7:30am to the last cup past midnight.

source.primary: In-store menu card, photographed and published on the cafe's Google listing (4 pages).
source.priceVerification: Read from the four in-store menu photos on Google at 1600px, with uncertain prices re-cropped and re-read at 2.2x. The older Linktree PDF was transcribed separately and cross-checked against Zomato's copy (90/90 match) - it is kept as the archive, and the differences are listed below.
openQuestions: THEIR LINKTREE PDF IS OUT OF DATE. The in-store card is a newer edition: it adds Signature Mocktail, Hummus Special and Salads, adds Godfather, Ferrero Rocher Cheesecake, Organic Farm Pizza, Triple Thread Nachos, Arrabbiata, Grilled Veggie Bagel, Avocado Dilight Focaccia and Strawberry/Blueberry Shakes, and drops Kheema Pizza, Farm House, Mexican Quesadilla, Burrito Bowl, Edamame & Mushroom, Paneer Salad Panini, Piri Piri Paneer Open Toast, Fig & Honey and Pineapple Cheesecake, Roasted Almond Hot Chocolate, Pasta Al Pesto, Creamy Bolognese and Modern Indian (Hummus Papdi Chaat, Soya Bhurji). Confirm the card is current before publishing.

Repricing to confirm: Espresso 140 to 120, Cafe Mocha 240 to 260, Espresso Tonic 220 to 240, frappes 280/300 to 300/320, shakes 280 to 300, mocktails 300/320 down to 250/270, Pesto Veggie Sandwich 295 to 385, Strawberry Cheesecake 320 to 350, Herbs Rice 345 to 375.

PIN: Google 395013 vs printed menu 395006. Page shows 395013.

The new card has no non-vegetarian item (Kheema Pizza is gone), so every item is marked veg. Confirm.
